title: The Lost Caravan
text: A merchant's caravan, wheels sunk to the hubs in the grey ground, mules dead in their traces. The drivers huddle under the wagons and will not come out. Something has been circling them for days. They will pay well, they say, to be walked home.

options.label: Walk them home, through whatever has been circling them.

outcomes.text: They reach the settlement a week behind you, and tell everyone who saved them. Their stock is better for it, and so is your name.
Something wants the caravan more than you do, and it has been waiting for you to lead it out.

options.label: The poorest House helps itself to the wagons. The drivers will not live to need them.

outcomes.text: The drivers do not fight. They only watch from under the wagons, and remember your colors, and tell everyone who will listen.
